core_obligations: Locality: (1) and (2) pass to f^{-1}(V) -> V for quasi-compact opens (extend-trivial lemma), so reduce to affine Y', Y.
(a): for affine g, g_* = Rg_* and the identity g_*(R^i f'_* F') = H^i(Rf_* Rg'_* F') gives vanishing from assumption (2).

(b): the functor F(M) = H^d(X', F' \otimes (f')^* M~) is right exact (vanishing of H^{d+1}) and commutes with direct sums (qqc + cohomology-colimit lemma); tensor representation turns it into the displayed isomorphism.
(c): the base change map gamma is the degree-d cohomology of Lh^*Rf'_* -> Rf''_*L(h')^*; its content is invertibility, proven on affines via (b) applied to R''-coefficients.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to affines on the base.
(b) by the tensor-representation of a right-exact direct-sum-preserving functor.
(c) by reading gamma through (b) on rings.
difficulty_reason: Three-part statement: affine-case vanishing computation for (a); an Eilenberg-Watts argument for (b) (right exactness from the vanishing, direct-sum commutation from qqc, tensor representation); explicit base-change map analysis for (c) using Lh^* and the cohomological shift. Requires sheafification of functor categories and derived-image bookkeeping.

compared.difference: That lemma gives finite generation of the top direct image for a finite-type sheaf; this one gives the base-change behaviour of the top direct image under a cohomological-dimension bound. Different statements; used there as a cited step.
